observations: Photo 0: Black Nikon DSLR body with 'Nikon' logo visible, mounted with a telephoto zoom lens, sitting on a box printed 'McSteve Online Gadget Store'.
Photo 1: Top-down view showing lens barrel marked 'Nikon AF-P DX NIKKOR 70-300mm 1:4.5-6.3G ED' and focal length markings (70,100,135,200,300).
Photo 2: Side view of camera body showing visible wear/scuffing and discoloration on the hand-grip rubber, lens front element visible but image resolution too low to confirm fungus or scratches.
No photo shows the LCD screen, menu, shutter count readout, battery, charger, or any power-on state.
No sample photograph taken by the camera is shown to confirm image quality or sensor function.

identity.model: D3400 with AF-P DX Nikkor 70-300mm f/4.5-6.3G ED lens

claims.claim: working perfectly ok with no fault
claims.evidence: No photo shows the camera powered on, LCD screen, or a test shot.
No screenshot of shutter count software or menu display provided.

claims.claim: no fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows lens front but resolution is too low and lighting insufficient to confirm internal clarity.
Neither battery nor charger appears in any of the 3 photos.
Internal repair history cannot be seen from exterior photos.

risks.risk: Shutter count could be much higher than claimed, affecting shutter lifespan and value.
risks.proof: Photo/screenshot of shutter count via camera menu or software (e.g., Nikon shutter count tool).
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-use/unknown shutter count, same tier as an unverified-condition body

risks.risk: Sensor or autofocus fault not visible externally.
risks.proof: A sample photo or video of the camera powering on and taking a shot.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working, i.e. at worst-case functional risk

risks.risk: Visible wear on grip (photo 2) suggests heavier use than 'like new' claim implies.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of all body edges and grip under good light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically used/worn, not mint

risks.risk: Battery and charger may not be original or included at all.
risks.proof: Photo of battery model number and charger label alongside camera.

risks.risk: Lens could have internal fungus or haze not visible in current low-res lens photo.
risks.proof: Macro photo of lens with a flashlight shone through from the rear element.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possible lens defect, same as having a flawed lens

proof_requests: Photo/video of camera powered on, showing the LCD menu and shutter count.
A sample photo taken with the camera and this lens, straight out of camera.
Clear photo of battery and charger with visible model numbers.
Macro photo of the lens elements with backlight to check for fungus/haze.
Close-up photos of all body corners and the grip area for full cosmetic condition.
response.reason: The camera and lens are clearly identified from the photos (Nikon D3400 with AF-P 70-300mm lens), but none of the seller's condition claims (shutter count, working state, lens clarity, originality) are verifiable from the images, and visible grip wear contradicts an implied like-new condition, so it must be priced at worst case pending further proof.
